tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Free. Lists the paid data tools, prices in USD, limits and how payment works.

tools.name: clean_csv
tools.description: $1.00 per job. Cleans a messy CSV/TSV/JSON table: auto-detects delimiter, snake_cases and de-duplicates headers, trims whitespace, turns blanks/"N/A" into null, drops empty rows/columns and exact duplicate rows, infers integers/numbers/booleans, converts dates to ISO 8601, lowercases emails and form

tools.name: validate_data
tools.description: $0.75 per job. Checks every row of a CSV/TSV/JSON/JSONL table against a simple column schema (type: string|integer|number|boolean|date|email|url|phone; required; unique; min/max; minLength/maxLength; pattern; enum). Returns a pass/fail verdict, invalid-row count, counts per column and rule, and up t

tools.name: convert_format
tools.description: $0.50 per job. Converts a table between formats. Input: csv, tsv, json, jsonl, markdown. Output: csv, tsv, json, jsonl, markdown, html. Nested JSON objects are flattened to dot.notation columns. Quoting and escaping are handled correctly (RFC 4180 CSV). Returns a free preview and a paymentLink.

tools.name: get_job_result
tools.description: Free. Returns the full result of a paid job, or its status, preview and paymentLink if unpaid.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: validate_data · Public sink: validate_data · Destructive: convert_format.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: validate_data · Public sink: validate_data · Destructive: convert_format

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
